story_overview: Mina prepares a small cafe before opening, moves a white sugar jar into the pantry, then revisits the cafe and brings a folded newspaper to a window table. Other furnishings remain unchanged.

A closer customer-side view of the same cafe shows Mina sliding a white sugar jar toward the end of the counter.
From behind the counter, a reverse view shows Mina picking up the white sugar jar, with the cafe entrance visible across the room.
A tight view follows the sugar jar in Mina's hands as she walks through the pantry door; most tables are outside the frame.
action_descriptions: A wide entrance view establishes Mina and the cafe.
Mina slides a white sugar jar along the counter.
A reverse view shows Mina picking up the sugar jar.
Mina carries the sugar jar out through the pantry door.

video_prompts: Inside the small cafe pantry, a medium side view shows Mina placing the white sugar jar on a shelf. Only part of the pantry is visible.
action_descriptions: Mina places the sugar jar on a pantry shelf.

video_prompts: The same wide entrance view returns to the cafe. The sugar jar is absent from the counter, Mina is empty-handed, and the remaining layout is unchanged.
From the window side of the same cafe, Mina enters carrying a folded newspaper and places it on an empty table by the window.
A close view shows the folded newspaper resting on the window table, while the counter is only partly visible in the background.
action_descriptions: The cafe is revisited after the sugar jar has been removed.
Mina brings in a newspaper and places it on a window table.
A close view confirms the newspaper remains on the window table.
